ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (21) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Сказано с сердцем» (skazano s serdtsem) is the idiom 'said in anger', not 'said from the heart'; the opening thought restores «знай» (znai, 'know'), which the website had dropped, and keeps Tolstoy's 'one of two things' before three alternatives. Both «истина» (istina) and «правда» (pravda) are 'truth', and the generic «человек» (chelovek, 'person') takes 'he', not the website's 'they'.
